contents.title: Portfolio Platform
contents.summary: This site itself. I reworked it from a resume-like page into a portfolio structure that puts work and delivery approach first.
details: Role: Owned information architecture, UI implementation, and responsive tuning.
Decision: Reordered the page to lead with work, strengths, and delivery context instead of chronological history.
Outcome: The same single-page shell now reads more like a portfolio than a resume.

contents.title: Operations Dashboard Prototype
contents.summary: A dashboard prototype designed for fast operational decisions in an IoT-connected workflow.
details: Role: Covered requirement clarification, screen and API design, and backend implementation direction.
Decision: Prioritized a flow where device state, alerts, and action history can be traced without context switching.
Outcome: Prepared a base where operators can confirm status and perform first-response actions from one browser workflow.

contents.title: Mobile Companion App
contents.summary: A mobile implementation study for field use, with particular focus on UX decisions that depend on native integration.
details: Role: Implemented screens, handled native integration, and set up the local verification flow.
Decision: Emphasized responsibility boundaries that absorb device differences and keep troubleshooting reproducible.
Outcome: Improved not only the app implementation but also the workflow for ongoing iteration.
